verdictSummary: Individually, most scenarios are coachable with CLEAR A vs B and no hard geometric contradictions. As a GOLD REFERENCE for the remaining LW rebuild, the pilot is too RW-mirrored and not position-native enough. Approving it would bias the next 50 toward side-flipped wing content.
blockingIssues: Semantic near-duplicates of approved RW Gold: 947≈876, 949≈880, 950≈929, 945≈873
Pilot composition leans GENERIC WING / LW CONTEXTUAL rather than STRONGLY LW NATIVE
Perception over-tag: honest justified perception ≈ 8/10 (949 should be false); not a hard block alone
950 Expert label TOO HIGH for the stated cognitive load
nonBlockingStrengths: No AMBIGUOUS A vs B rankings from stated cues
949 geometry orientation is correct after correction (opp right back / right wing)
946 anti-folklore GK read with free LB is strong LW-native content
944 3:2:1 take-off and 942 5:1 outlet are good system-native seeds

scenarios.perceptionNote: Solved from positional principle and current stand location, not a changing external cue.
scenarios.lwNativeNote: Universal hold-width idea with LB partner; flips cleanly to RW.
scenarios.duplicationNote: Related to RW 887 width-for-drive; not the same cue stack.
scenarios.distractors: OK — early crowd LB is realistic; cut and early approach are distinct mistakes.
scenarios.tacticalNotes: Geometry clean. OPTIMAL does not rely on unstated assumptions.

scenarios.perceptionNote: Must read advanced-defender pressure plus WD hips/feet and open sideline pass.
scenarios.lwNativeNote: 5:1 advanced pressure on LB as left-side outlet partner is a left-wing cooperation problem.
scenarios.duplicationNote: Related to RW 872 hip-ask, but 5:1 advanced defender is the decision driver.
scenarios.tacticalNotes: Strong. B requires a beat that has not happened.

scenarios.perceptionNote: Feet/chest read before ball arrives drives the first movement.
scenarios.lwNativeNote: Same first-move feet read works on either wing.
scenarios.duplicationNote: Distinct from 941 (no cue read) and 942 (ask-now with LB ball).
scenarios.tacticalNotes: Clean. Early deep entry is correctly risky while ball is still far.

scenarios.perceptionNote: Half step-out + WD still pulled + open jump lane are live cues.
scenarios.lwNativeNote: 3:2:1 left-seam take-off with LB; finish explicitly deferred to GK next movement (no folklore).
scenarios.duplicationNote: Related to RW 871 take-off-while-WD-inside; creator cue is 3:2:1 half step-out.
scenarios.distractors: OK — standing extreme corner and return into stepped half are realistic.
scenarios.tacticalNotes: Complex geometry holds. First decision is take-off; GK finish remains conditional. No unstated assumption required for A over B.

scenarios.perceptionNote: Must integrate WD help step, live LB drive, and pivot occupancy.
scenarios.lwNativeNote: Left geometry with LB/pivot, but teaching is classic wing when-not-enter.
scenarios.duplicationNote: Very close to RW 873 when-not-enter (WD helping, back needs width, stay wide). Extra pivot-stack detail reduces but does not erase the overlap.
scenarios.tacticalNotes: Strong teaching scenario on its own; weak as a uniqueness pillar versus RW Gold.

scenarios.perceptionNote: GK hands + free LB + late WD + open lane must be combined.
scenarios.lwNativeNote: Inside release partner is LB from left wing; anti-automatic-lob is the teaching point.
scenarios.duplicationNote: Not RW finish-folklore; free-teammate fork is the difference.
scenarios.distractors: OK — body shot and full reset are realistic.
scenarios.tacticalNotes: Question restates cues (slight quiz smell) but A vs B ranking is still forced by the situation. Minor non-blocking concern.

scenarios.perceptionNote: Recovering defender covering middle is the decisive cue.
scenarios.duplicationNote: Teaching decision matches RW 876: first-wave 3v2, middle covered, hold wing width to six. Left/right flip does not create a new concept.
scenarios.tacticalNotes: Good scenario quality; fails uniqueness as LW gold reference seed.

scenarios.perceptionNote: WD narrow + pivot still in left corridor is a genuine multi-player read.
scenarios.lwNativeNote: 6v5 left-corridor pivot seal vs entry is a left-wing numerical cooperation problem.
scenarios.duplicationNote: Not RW 878. Versus 945: both reject attractive entry, but 948 is 6v5 stretch + pivot-corridor cue; 945 is 6v6 LB-drive outlet. Distinct enough.
scenarios.tacticalNotes: 948 special recheck PASS vs 945 and vs RW 878.

scenarios.perceptionNote: Primary skill is applying an explicitly stated team rule plus a controlled-help principle; absence of handover call is not a rich perceptual discrimination.
scenarios.lwNativeNote: Correct left-side opponent labels, but same defensive curriculum as RW wing help/handover.
scenarios.duplicationNote: Teaching matches RW 880: protect wing pass until handover, controlled help, do not fully leave. Side-correct mirror.
scenarios.distractors: OK — full abandon vs zero help are distinct mistakes.
scenarios.tacticalNotes: Geometry orientation CORRECT (opp right back + right wing). Quality fine; uniqueness fails for gold reference.

scenarios.perceptionNote: Teammate map + own-side runner + ball middle-left require a live priority read.
scenarios.difficultyNote: Two clear cues and a stated teammate assignment fit Advanced more than Expert.
scenarios.lwNativeNote: Same own-side lane priority as RW transition-defence 3v2 family (929).
scenarios.duplicationNote: Matches RW 929 decision: own sideline pass is yours when teammate already covers far wing.
scenarios.distractors: OK — far-chase myth and stop-to-signal are realistic.
scenarios.tacticalNotes: Strong transition teaching; not LW-unique enough as a gold seed.

special948.vs945: DISTINCT — 6v5 + pivot corridor vs 6v6 LB drive outlet; related family of ideas but different decision fork

pilotAsGoldReference.why: 4/10 strongly LW-native is not enough to authorize a 50-scenario expansion without inheriting RW mirror patterns. Three hard DUPLICATE links to RW Gold (947/949/950) block reference approval.
whatWouldBeNeededBeforeApproval: Replace or deeply re-native 947, 949, 950 with left-unique forks (not side flips)
Either accept 945 as universal wing principle explicitly or rework its cue away from RW 873
Retag perception honesty on 949 (report only noted; not edited)
Retag 950 difficulty to Advanced (report only noted; not edited)
